headword: {特別警報|とくべつけいほう}

definitions.explanation: The highest level of weather or disaster warning issued by the Japan Meteorological Agency, indicating an imminent threat of severe disaster requiring immediate protective action.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧{特別警報|とくべつけいほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A special heavy rain warning was issued.

examples.japanese: {特別警報|とくべつけいほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}たら→出る：00513_deru⟧、ただちに⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確保|かくほ}→確保：13681_kakuho⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: If a special warning is issued, immediately ensure your safety.

examples.japanese: ⟦{気象庁|きしょうちょう}→気象庁：30107_kishouchou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{伴|ともな}う→伴う：10389_tomonau⟧⟦{暴風|ぼうふう}→暴風：07951_boufuu⟧{特別警報|とくべつけいほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発令|はつれい}→発令：09516_hatsurei⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The Japan Meteorological Agency issued a special storm warning associated with the typhoon.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{特別|とくべつ}→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧ (special) + ⟦{警報|けいほう}→警報：09515_keihou⟧ (warning). The highest tier in the Japan Meteorological Agency's three-level warning system, introduced in 2013.

WARNING LEVELS (from lowest to highest):
- ⟦{注意報|ちゅういほう}→注意報：16464_chuuihou⟧: advisory — be aware
- ⟦{警報|けいほう}→警報：09515_keihou⟧: warning — take precautions
- {特別警報|とくべつけいほう}: special warning — extreme danger, take immediate action

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {特別警報|とくべつけいほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}される→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧: a special warning is issued
- {特別警報|とくべつけいほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発令|はつれい}→発令：09516_hatsurei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to issue a special warning
- ⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧{特別警報|とくべつけいほう}: special heavy rain warning
- ⟦{暴風|ぼうふう}→暴風：07951_boufuu⟧{特別警報|とくべつけいほう}: special storm warning
- ⟦{大雪|おおゆき}→大雪：03017_ooyuki⟧{特別警報|とくべつけいほう}: special heavy snow warning

- ⟦{避難指示|ひなんしじ}→避難指示：20801_hinanshiji⟧: evacuation order
- ⟦{気象庁|きしょうちょう}→気象庁：30107_kishouchou⟧: Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA)
- ⟦{防災|ぼうさい}→防災：07907_bousai⟧: disaster prevention
